criteria.evidence: Frozen snapshot 232f5d3e1c04cf155b6b0c96f85f988dec93c9588f6a2a70a2b9d7ef165a88d2 matches the manifest hashes. In remote.mjs, publish pushes only EXPECTED_HEAD:refs/heads/STORY_BRANCH at lines 599-617; merge requires READY checks, rechecks the exact PR, and invokes gh with --match-head-commit at lines 672-704; open queue results remain MERGE_PENDING and postmerge identity/base mismatches do not report completion. tests/remote.test.mjs uses an injected fake runner and contains explicit missing-auth, pending/failed/unknown-check, changed-head race, rejected/queued merge, merge mismatch, and read-only exact/advanced reconciliation cases. The exact-snapshot npm test receipt is PASS with 349/349 tests, 0 failures, duration 486440.215083 ms, log SHA-256 c9d9db3a032c7b3118c6db27076ca91bb4c46d2776429878a597362e0c501299; npm run validate is PASS with log SHA-256 6e13c61ea3c623487770df0fd4a6c35da4a9cb8a72bea51a94775f591e10ad88. post-gate-check.json retains the same snapshot at revision 19.

Current source has reachable lifecycle failures despite the green declared gates. First, executeProviderAttempt records PR_DRAFT/CHECKS_PENDING/CHECKS_FAILED as observed with active disposition and no effect at integration.mjs:1859-1873, while state.mjs:202-207 rejects that exact state as 'unresolved attempt has effect'; the current-snapshot reproduction log records pending-check merge throwing that error and remaining stuck when checks become ready. Second, MERGE_PENDING is retained as observed without an effect, but reconcileRemoteSource only settles an active_token at integration.mjs:2158-2169 and later writes source proof without creating the required merge effect; state.mjs:377-391 rejects it. The same raw reproduction records a later real server merge failing with 'source proof binding'. Third, reconcileRemoteHandoffRepair checks exact [attempt.parent,H2] parents at integration.mjs:3026-3028 before its fetched-tip race branch at :3029, so a true provider-side premerge base advance throws instead of retaining HANDOFF_BASE_RACE and spending the bounded replacement retry required by remote-lifecycle-interface.md:31. Fourth, prepareRemoteClosureCheckout at :2392-2407 retains no finalization identity, assertRemoteEvidenceMutable at :2457-2459 freezes only after an artifact starts, and gate/review/verification operations may clear finalization at :2326/:2341/:2357. Artifact preparation at :2601-2628 does not re-require finalized evidence, so it can persist a generation with null finalization and then wedge adoption while freezing further evidence repair. These are current source defects, not the stale external receipt. The external objections to fresh-process replay and to replacing effect-bound premerge N do not establish failures: T05B-operation-dispatch.md:53 explicitly permits replay only after same-process ended proof, and T05B-fix2-design-preflight-native.json:14 explicitly defines N as the effect-bound premerge observation.

The 349-test gate exercises many real temporary-Git and fake-provider paths, but it does not demonstrate the complete required lifecycle on the current implementation. Its logged queue case is only 'queued merge observation cannot replay an ended merge invocation'; the current-snapshot defect reproduction at .deliver/checkpoints/T05B-fix3-candidate/fable-current-repro.log, SHA-256 f4e1910db93598ea56365f96ded451f69e685b8375850d6ea0b943f18af11e18, proves both the pending-check durable-state failure and failure to adopt a later queued merge. The H2 implementation rejects a true base race before recording race_proof, and closure checkout permits finalization invalidation before P/E/H preparation. Therefore the passing suite does not prove queue completion, true H2/S replacement after a provider-side premerge race, or immutable finalization through checkout and artifact preparation. Those missing working paths are expressly required by remote-lifecycle-interface.md:47 and prevent a full publish-through-fresh-process-handoff acceptance.
